command:
set -eu
umask 077
key_tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/os-comparison-ca-key.XXXXXX)
crt_tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/os-comparison-ca-crt.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$key_tmp" "$crt_tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes \
  -keyout "$key_tmp" -out "$crt_tmp" \
  -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' \
  -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' \
  -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' \
  -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash'
install -o root -g root -m 0600 "$key_tmp" /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$crt_tmp" /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
update-ca-trust extract
printf 'installed key_mode='; stat -c '%a owner=%U group=%G' /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
